senses.gloss: m. (וס for יס; κυβευστης = κυβιστής, S.) gambler; (= κυβευτικός) crafty person.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 847:1">Yalk. Deut. 847</cite> <he>זה הוא ק׳ וכ׳</he> this man is a gambler, and he may go and gamble and lose &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 4:7">Tosef. B. Bath. IV, 7</cite> <he>המוכר … ונמצא גנב או ק׳</he> if one sells a slave …, and he turns out to be a thief or a crafty person (swindler), contrad. to <cite ref="L00498"><he>ליסטיס</he></cite>; Y. ib. VII, end, 15ᵈ; Bab.

<cite ref="Chullin 91b:13">Ḥull. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>גנב אתה או ק׳ וכ׳</he> art thou a thief or a burglar that thou art afraid of the morning?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 133:8">Yalk. Gen. 133</cite>.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 5a:11">Bekh. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>משה … או ק׳ וכ׳</he> your teacher Moses was either a thief or a swindler, or else a bad arithmetician.
